title: DLQEnvelope
description: Dead Letter Queue envelope schema. When a consumer (consumers/dlq_handler.py) cannot process a message — due to schema violations, parse errors, or repeated processing failures — it wraps the raw message in this envelope and publishes it to the 'logs-dlq' Kafka topic. Person 3's FastAPI (/dlq/messages) reads from this topic/table and exposes it to the React dashboard (Person 4).

original_message.description: The original payload that failed processing. If the payload was valid JSON it is embedded as an object; if it was malformed/unparseable it is stored as a raw string. Consumers MUST NOT modify this field.

failure_reason.description: Human-readable description of why the message failed. Examples: 'JSON schema validation failed: trace_id missing', 'Deserialization error: invalid UTF-8', 'Processing timeout after 3 retries'.

retry_count.description: Number of times dlq_handler.py attempted to reprocess this message before routing it to the DLQ. A value of 0 means it was never retried (immediate DLQ). The retry ceiling is configurable in dlq_handler.py.

failed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the final failure event — i.e., when the message was placed into the DLQ after exhausting retries.

examples.failure_reason: JSON schema validation failed: required field 'trace_id' is missing
